description: Calculate EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (Reg (EU) 2023/956) embedded direct and indirect emissions, the Art. 31 free allocation adjustment (CBAM factor times the Reg (EU) 2025/2620 CBAM benchmark), required CBAM certificates, and total euro cost for an imported product given CN code, country of origin, quantity in metric tonnes, and import year (2026-2034).

carbonPricePaid.description: Optional verified carbon price effectively paid in the country of origin (EUR/tCO2e) under Art. 9.

cn.description: Combined Nomenclature (CN) or TARIC code at 4, 6, 8, or 10 digits.

origin.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of origin code (e.g. TR, CN, IN, US).

tonnes.description: Net mass in metric tonnes (or MWh for electricity).

name: cbam_resolve
title: Calculate CBAM Obligations
